articles.headline: הודעה למשקיעי UWMC: משרד רוזן עורכי דין מזכיר למשקיעי UWM Holdings Corporation  שספגו הפסדים העולים על 100,000 דולר, כי המועד האחרון להגשת בקשה לשמש כתובע המרכזי בתביעה ייצוגית בניירות ערך הוא ה-13 באוקטובר 2026
articles.summary: Rosen Law Firm reminds UWM Holdings Corporation investors who suffered losses exceeding $100,000 that the deadline to apply as lead plaintiff in a securities class action is October 13, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that UWM Holdings made false or misleading statements regarding its mortgage servicing rights (MSR) hedging strategy and failed to disclose excessive hedging positions related to a Two Harbors transaction, resulting in investor losses.

articles.headline: UWMC INVESTOR ALERT: Rosen Law Firm Reminds UWM Holdings Corporation Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K of October 13, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline in Securities Class Action
articles.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against UWM Holdings Corporation for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements regarding its mortgage servicing rights (MSRs) hedging strategy and hedge position related to the Two Harbors transaction. The lawsuit claims the company deviated from its traditional non-hedging strategy, over-hedged its position, and created excess hedging risk while making positive statements about its business. Investors with losses exceeding $100K who purchased securities between March 9, 2026 and August 5, 2026 have until October 13, 2026 to seek appointment as lead plaintiff.

articles.headline: DEADLINE ALERT for BETR, DOCS, BIDU, UWMC: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith Reminds Investors of Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Class Actions
articles.summary: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith has filed securities fraud class action lawsuits against four publicly-traded companies: Better Home & Finance (BETR), Doximity (DOCS), Baidu (BIDU), and UWM Holdings (UWMC). The lawsuits allege that defendants made materially false statements and failed to disclose material adverse facts about their business operations. Investors have until specified deadlines in October and November 2026 to file lead plaintiff motions.
